title: Kenyan Bisque Soup
description: A creamy Kenyan-inspired soup made with a rich bisque, served with a side of aerated flatbread

ingredients.name: Non-dairy milk
ingredients.notes: such as almond or soy milk

instructions: In a large pot, sauté the tripe in a little bit of oil until lightly browned
Add the vegetable broth, non-dairy milk, and Kenyan bisque to the pot
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and let simmer for 10 minutes
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth
Stir in the resinous herbs and aerated flatbread slices
Season with salt and pepper to taste
Serve hot, garnished with additional herbs if desired
